llm_response.reason: The site displays clear scam characteristics: extremely wide product range, excessive and unrealistic discounts, 'free shipping on all items', and no verifiable company or contact info. The contact email uses an unprofessional, unrelated domain. There is strong use of psychological urgency and price-driven tactics targeting common scam victim profiles. These align with most of the scam characteristics for fake online shopping scams, and are supported by industry and consumer protection guidelines.
